body:
Can anyone reproduce it with GdScript?

--------

Minimal reproduction project (MRP)
> Note for C# users: If your issue is not C#-specific, please upload a minimal reproduction project written in GDScript. This will make it easier for contributors to reproduce the issue locally as not everyone has a .NET setup available.

Not sure if it's a bug or expected behavior, but I get the same behavior with the MRP ported to GDScript, so either way it's not .NET-specific. Here's the MRP ported to GDScript:

[ThemeBugGD.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20929917/ThemeBugGD.tar.gz)

I also hit this issue and did some digging. From what I could tell, theme value lookups are only aware of classes that exist on the C++ side. Script classes for both GDScript and C# are ignored.

I think the most straightforward solution would be to add an argument for `Script` in the various theme lookups to add the script hierarchy when looking up which class names to check, but it would only work for scripts marked as a global class and would need to be noted in the docs.
